svg.aria-label: How to write ഥ: one unbroken stroke · 3 movements
svg.title: Writing ഥ
svg.desc: 3 frames; frame N shows movements 1 to N of ഥ (malayalam), the movement being added drawn in ink over the finished letter, whose outline is read from _fonts/NotoSansMalayalam-Static.ttf. Stroke order after Rodney F. Moag, Malayalam: A University Course and Reference Grammar (University of Texas at Austin South Asia Institute and COERLL, updated April 2018; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), Table IV 'How to Write Consonant Symbols', p. xxviii: movements 1-3 for ഥ, written by hand by Thomas Joseph <https://github.com/matjic/malayalam/blob/7141acd2f310bc8928822a7aec61d1149efa6fa3/docs/assets/images/front-writing-038.jpg>. Source note on variation: Moag's Table IV (p. xxviii) starts at the top of the left stem and runs down it (1), runs right along the base (2), then climbs the right leg, arches anticlockwise over the top and comes down the inner leg to the base (3). Moag's book is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, so only these facts (order, start, direction and end) are cited; no drawing is copied. The page is read from the scan in Mathew Jacob's digital edition (github.com/matjic/malayalam, commit 7141acd), which notes that the numbers mark drawing movements that can belong to one continuous stroke, not pen lifts. The grahyam online-handwriting samples (github.com/bluebottlewize/grahyam, no licence, cited as counts only) keep no pen-up marker, but none of the 34 unique samples jumps between consecutive points the way a lift would; they most often start at the upper left (34 of 34) and end at the lower centre (26 of 34). SPACE Kerala's Thooval (GPL-3.0, facts only) starts its THA.png at the upper left and ends it at the lower centre. The path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Malayalam outline rather than to Moag's drawing.
svg.text: How it is written — one unbroken stroke · 3 movements
Stroke order after Rodney F. Moag, Malayalam: A University Course and Reference Grammar
(University of Texas at Austin South Asia Institute and COERLL, updated April 2018; CC
BY-NC-SA 4.0), Table IV 'How to Write Consonant Symbols', p. xxviii: movements 1-3 for ഥ,

This order is attested, not standardised; the source records where it varies.
